checks.text: At 375 px the WIR shows the checklist with the three items
Each item has Pass, Fail and N/A segmented controls
The controls are large enough to tap (at least 40 px high)
On a Fail whose template requires them, the comment and photo show required
A failed item can raise a Snag, ticked by default
A summary reads like 1 Pass / 1 Fail / 1 N/A with progress
It saved as it went (the api holds the answers)

notes: The WIR is left with Ahmed (answers saved, not sent).
